Hi.Alan.
Thank you for your reply.

Do you have the following certifications?

For EMC testing, test results from a VCCI-accredited testing facility are
required.

・Safety Standards Test Report (JIS C 62368-1 or equivalent IEC standard)

・EMC Test Report (EN 55032/55024 or VCCI Class A/B)

・RoHS Declaration of Conformity

For more details, please discuss this with Inoue at CC.

Best regards.

Hi, Osako,
Thanks for your information.

1. Please check attached file to know more about us.

*Please read "must know“ info!!*2. Company history: we are a small company
founded in 2023, though short, we have our own business rules and mature
product portfolio.
About sales performance, we only focus on EU market and industrial managed
switches.
About those switches with PoE watchdog feature, it is not our focus to be
honest.
But its quality is good enough.
JP market is blank for us, that is why we are willing to send a piece for
your testing, which is against our regular practice.
Please just consider it a trial piece to know the features.
You do not have to introduce or promote it before you finally device to use
our products.

Please let me know your feedback.
Thank you.
